item.title: Fact Check: Mass blackout warning attributed online to Britain's National Grid is fake
item.description: Confirmed by at least two independent outlets. Sources: Reuters https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/mass-blackout-warning-attributed-online-britains-national-grid-is-fake-2026-11-17/ · Full Fact https://fullfact.org/hoaxes/national-grid-warning-major-UK-blackout-outage-fake/
